decisions.coverageKnown: Official municipal tariff page states five municipal charging points, EVCharge operation and a public price of 0.30 EUR/kWh with a two-hour charging limit.
decisions.resumeCondition: Revalidate if the municipality publishes a later tariff/order or REVE connector mapping differs deterministically.

decisions.coverageKnown: Official municipality confirms EVCharge-managed public network. On 2026-09-09 the council approved 0.24 EUR/kWh plus VAT for municipality-operated points.
decisions.blockingReason: The approved 0.24 EUR/kWh + VAT price only enters into force the day after publication in the BOPB; no confirming BOPB publication was located during this first pass, so the approved future price is not promoted as active yet.
decisions.resumeCondition: Confirm BOPB publication/effective date, then promote the official tariff if still applicable.
